title: The loudest sound in history (was heard 3,000 miles away)

hook.narration: The loudest sound ever: an island that blew itself apart.

visual.prop: Krakatoa island OWNS the frame + blast rings + kinetic title

fact_sources: loudest sound in recorded history, 27 Aug 1883 Krakatoa blast (Wikipedia '1883 eruption of Krakatoa'; Nautilus 'The Sound So Loud That It Circled the Earth Four Times', 2014)

scenes.narration: In eighteen eighty three, Krakatoa was an island near Java.

visual.prop: island wide shot + '1883' stamp, Java/Sumatra silhouettes at frame edges

fact_sources: eruption 27 August 1883, Sunda Strait between Java and Sumatra (Wikipedia '1883 eruption of Krakatoa') — date as '1883' STAMP on screen; VO says the year as words

scenes.narration: A hundred miles out, it rated about one hundred eighty decibels.

visual.prop: barograph gauge OWNS the frame — needle slams past + '180 dB' stamp

fact_sources: calculated 180 dB SPL at 160 km / 100 mi (Wikipedia); Batavia gasworks barometer 2.5 inHg ≈ 172 dB (Nautilus 2014) — 'about', never 'measured'; '180 dB' as STAMP, VO says words

scenes.narration: Pain kicks in around one hundred and thirty. This was fifty past it.

visual.prop: giant ear + red-zone arc past the 130 mark, hero small at edge

scenes.narration: Forty miles out, over half a ship's crew had their eardrums burst.

visual.prop: ship silhouette OWNS the frame + 'CRACK' stamp, sailors hands to ears

fact_sources: Norham Castle 40 mi: 'ear-drums of over half my crew have been shattered' — captain's log (via Nautilus 2014)

scenes.narration: Three thousand miles away, people blamed a nearby ship's cannons.
fact_sources: heard 4,800 km / 3,000 mi away at Rodrigues; 'thought to have been cannon fire from a nearby ship' (Wikipedia)

scenes.narration: The pressure wave circled the entire planet. Three and a half times.

visual.prop: globe OWNS the frame — one pressure ring orbiting + '3.5×' stamp

fact_sources: barographs recorded the wave 7 times over 5 days = 3.5 circuits of the globe (Wikipedia)

scenes.narration: The waves it made killed thirty six thousand people.

visual.prop: dark swell over a village silhouette

fact_sources: official Dutch toll 36,417, mostly by the ~30 m tsunami; 165 coastal settlements swept (Wikipedia; Nautilus 2014) — 'the waves it made' = the tsunami

scenes.narration: And the island that made the sound was gone.

visual.prop: island splits and sinks into the sea

fact_sources: Krakatoa island largely destroyed in the eruption (Wikipedia)

scenes.narration: But Earth wasn't finished. A new island rose, the child of Krakatoa.

visual.prop: small sprouting cone island + 'ANAK KRAKATAU' stamp

fact_sources: Anak Krakatau rose permanently above sea level 11 Aug 1930; 'Anak Krakatau' = 'child of Krakatoa' (Wikipedia 'Anak Krakatau'). Indonesian name lives in the 'ANAK KRAKATAU' STAMP (ASR cannot carry it, day-013); VO says 'the child of Krakatoa'

scenes.narration: It's been growing for nearly a century — and it could do it all again.

visual.prop: growth rings pulse on the cone + kinetic closer

fact_sources: Anak Krakatau still active — Sept 2026 eruption ongoing; grew ~7–9 m/yr before 2018; 96 years since 1930 = 'nearly a century' (Wikipedia)
